The razor-like blade is as merciless as death itself, the guard is fashioned from premium materials, and the handle is crafted so exquisitely it belongs in a museum. Most importantly, it remains light and nimble to wield because it was forged DRM-free.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: Melee

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When making an Attack with this weapon, the user ignores all Armor, Facedown, Critical Injury, and Wound State related Attack Check penalties they are currently suffering (if any).

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
